name: Understand the Dev & Supply
question: Who holds the tokens, what can the dev change, and how do they get paid?
intro: Start with the basic terms, why the risks matter, and how the dev and traders affect each other. Then work through the checks and record your findings.
principle: Check why people might buy and what could affect their ability to sell. Record the evidence, time, and unanswered questions for each check.
